newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Pope arrives in Prague for Czech visit.
newsitem.headline: Pope arrives in Prague for Czech visit.

text.p: Pope John Paul arrived in Prague on Friday at the start of a three-day visit to the Czech Republic.
The Pontiff's Alitalia jet touched down at Prague airport where Czech President Vaclav Havel was waiting to greet him on his third visit to the city since the fall of communism in 1989.
The 76-year-old Pope, wearing a white overcoat against the cold, walked slowly down the aircraft steps and shook hands with Havel before touching a symbolic pot of Czech earth.
Some 200 children, waving yellow and white Vatican flags, were also at the airport to meet him. An army band played national anthems while a guard of honour stood to attention.

Pope John Paul, whose health has been fragile in recent years, will hold two open-air masses, including one for young people to commemorate the 1,000th anniversary of the death of St Adalbert, or Vojtech in Czech.
The Pope will also meet Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus and join other church leaders in ecumenical worship on Sunday before flying back to Rome.
